tasks.label: GIT DIFF -> clipboard
tasks.command: $d = git diff --ignore-cr-at-eol -- '${relativeFile}'; Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Windows.Forms; $n = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.NotifyIcon; $n.Icon = [System.Drawing.SystemIcons]::Information; $n.Visible = $true; if ($d) { $d | clip; $n.ShowBalloonTip(3000, 'Diff COPIADO', '${fileBasename}', 'Info') } else { $n.ShowBalloonTip(3000, 'Diff VAZIO', '${fileBasename}', 'Warning') }; Start-Sleep -Seconds 3; $n.Dispose()
